title: TensorPlate BufferRef
description: Opaque buffer-handle identity. The schema is intentionally NOT a memory-transfer wire format; it carries only the metadata required to compare buffer identities across logs, traces, and test fixtures. Mirrors include/tensorplate/buffer/buffer_ref.hpp::BufferRef.

id.description: Unique identity within the buffer pool lifetime. The value 0 is the released sentinel and is paired with `ownership` `released`.

size_bytes.description: Allocated size in bytes. Must be > 0 for `owned` / `borrowed`; 0 only for the released sentinel.

ownership.description: Coarse ownership state. See header for the responsibility matrix.
